summary.headline: Law, Religion, and Visions
summary.text: Chapter 29, “On the law, religion, and visions of the native,” directs judgment of faith and dreams through the Third and Ninth houses, their planets, rulers, dignities, aspects, lots, signs, house positions, and planetary conditions. It also notes Mercury’s special significance and begins interpreting Mercury in Saturn’s house or aspect as depth of knowledge; the preceding lines describe journeys indicated by the lot of journeys, Mars, the ascendant lord, and the Moon.
